hook_line: 181 OFF 68 BALLS: SECOND-HIGHEST SCORE IN T20 HISTORY

hook_stat.sub: Priyansh Arya's score off 68 balls for Delhi against Tamil Nadu — the highest T20 score by an Indian

news_summary: Delhi captain Priyansh Arya scored 181 off 68 balls against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy in Indore, the second-highest score in men's T20 history, as Delhi won by 116 runs.
payoff: Arya finished seven runs short of Lhuan-dre Pretorius's world record of 188 not out.

stats.label: Sixes — equalling Finn Allen's world record for a T20 innings
For Arya's century — his fifty took 18 balls and his 150 a tournament-record 60
Delhi's winning margin — Delhi posted 275 for 5 and Tamil Nadu were bowled out for 159
